title: The Ash Pole Primer
summary: A first reader for untrained hands on how to hold, stand and thrust with a plain ash-hafted spear.

title: Leaf-Blade Beginner's Handbook
summary: Teaches the grip, the line of the point and the first cuts of the leaf-shaped spearhead to new students.

title: A Hunter's Spear Drill-Book
summary: Sets out the braced stance, the set point and the killing thrust used against a charging animal or man.

title: The Plain Thrust Workbook
summary: A set of daily drills for building a straight, steady spear thrust through repetition of the one motion.

title: Spear and Footwork Treatise for the Untempered
summary: Trains students to move before they thrust, linking each spear motion to a foot placement that keeps balance.

title: Watchman's Short-Spear Notes
summary: Notes on a short spear for crowded places, covering close thrusts, butt strikes and holding a doorway of space.

title: The Circulating Thrust: A First Spear Treatise
summary: Introduces qi circulation into the thrust, teaching new second-awakeners to send breath and force down the haft.

title: Elementary Spear Canon of Reach and Return
summary: A school primer on thrusting out to full reach and recovering the point to guard before the target answers.

title: Handbook of the Breath-Led Spear
summary: Shows how steady breath carries qi along the length of the haft to give the point accuracy and body.

title: The Short Shaft and Long Shaft Primer
summary: Compares fighting with the spear gripped long and gripped short and teaches how to change grip mid-exchange.

title: Spear Fundamentals with Qi Along the Haft
summary: A broad grounding in the thrust, the parry and the stepping that make up the spear's body of basic forms.

title: Notes on the Haft and the Butt: A Spear Without Its Point
summary: Treats the spear as a staff, teaching strikes, blocks and sweeps made with the haft and the butt.
